mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY biz01_provide_company collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc) AS contact_id , biz01_provide_company AS contact_name FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_provide_company IS NOT NULL AND upper(biz01_provide_company) like upper(#{searchText}) GROUP BY biz01_provide_company
